scope.contract: P32 remains incomplete. Read only through an official surface; no persistent body ledger, implicit resume, prompts, or second Agent loop. Existing loaded-body search remains a separate proven scope.

recommendation.priority: First implement a narrowly declared official-message reader using the selected Claude ACP installation’s already present public SDK exports, after synthetic no-side-effect and completeness tests. It can search previously unloaded messages returned by that API; it cannot honestly claim full original history.
recommendation.notCompletion: API existence and source review are not product, installed-app, real-account, all-history or all-29 acceptance. Compressed-away messages, other branches, attachment entities and unsupported registrations remain explicit gaps.
recommendation.nextConditional: Codex thread/read has stronger explicit read semantics, but its integration needs a proven owned app-server route that neither starts a competing Agent controller nor alters storage on startup. Do not tunnel it through an unadvertised ACP extension.

currentPaths.finding: The current import preview uses open_session_owned/session_load. Discovery also connects first. Neither is a no-start bulk-reader shortcut.
Loading may connect_selected, restore saved configuration and send setters. No prompt is insufficient proof of no side effects. Standard ACP list is metadata, not body search.

Reuse cancellable visible-text extraction, temporary results and explicit coverage. Current limits are 1,048,576 characters per field, 16,777,216 total and 200 hits; the Worker wait limit is 10 seconds per field, not per query. Historical snapshots require their own source ownership, not a forged live Thread.

packageEvidence.exports: Package root exports sdk.mjs and sdk.d.ts. Public getSessionInfo(sessionId,{dir}) and getSessionMessages(sessionId,{dir,limit,offset}); listSessions({dir,includeWorktrees:false,...}) is optional discovery, not required for a first slice over existing Farfold index IDs. Versions describe the installed evidence, not a new pin or compatibility gate.

representatives.readPath: Installed getSessionMessages local path NQt → yY → aa/sVe → iVe/_Y. Inspected getter uses filesystem reads and message-chain projection; it does not call query or spawn the Agent CLI. Do not enable alpha sessionStore or call resume/query.
coverageLimits: Over 5 MiB, installed sVe normally reads only after the latest compact boundary. Small transcripts also pass through chain/visibility selection. Malformed lines may be skipped and missing/read failures may return empty results. Limit/offset is result pagination, not an input-memory bound.

Official Python get_session_messages also selects the current chain and does not traverse logicalParentUuid across compaction; it is not a full-history workaround. No Python package is proposed for installation.

dir constrains lookup but official lookup can consider linked worktrees. Revalidate returned session ID/cwd against the requested index scope; do not interpret directory alone as package ownership or authorization for all projects.
representatives.sideEffectStatus: Getter call graph inspected only. Module-import initialization, telemetry/network, concurrent-file behavior and complete filesystem write absence have not been executed or proved; synthetic isolated probes must gate availability.
representatives.cancel: No public AbortSignal in this installed getter signature. Use one dedicated, non-Agent reader helper per owned request; cancel its exact process and await reaping. Deadline/output-limit failure is unavailable or partial, never zero hits.
representatives.decision: Prioritized implementable partial route, conditional on probe gates below.

representatives.surface: Official app-server thread/read({threadId,includeTurns:true}) is documented to read stored turns without resuming or subscribing. thread/list.searchTerm is title search; its default source filter is not all sources. useStateDbOnly avoids list scan/repair work.
representatives.integrationGap: Current selected ACP adapter owns its app-server child transport; reviewed adapter surface did not expose this getter. Starting another server, even without a prompt, has not been proved write-free. Experimental turn/item pagination is not assumed available in the installed CLI.
representatives.cancel: If a valid owned route is later available, retire only the read request/results, not the shared Agent process; verify supported cancellation/time/output bounds. Do not resume to obtain bodies.
representatives.decision: Official getter exists; safe no-start integration remains unimplemented and untested.

representatives.surface: Official SDK createOpencodeClient can address an existing server; session.messages/message are read endpoints. createOpencode starts a server. SDK find.text searches project files, not conversation history.
representatives.sourceVersion: Official v1.18.31 CLI export source calls Session.get/messages, but effect-cmd defaults to an instance with bootstrap; bootstrap initializes plugins/configuration and services. A CLI export invocation is therefore not a proven passive reader.
representatives.integrationGap: Current ACP route has no verified separately addressable server endpoint. Never probe arbitrary localhost ports, reuse unrelated server credentials, or launch a new server automatically for search.
representatives.decision: Conditional existing, explicitly owned server route only; current product has no accepted unloaded-reader path.

representatives.packageEvidence: Installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.87.1; official v0.87.1 source was compared. No package was executed.
representatives.sideEffects: SessionManager.open/setSessionFile can migrate and rewrite files. Exported-for-testing loadEntriesFromFile appends a trailing newline when absent. Default session-directory resolution can create directories. These must not be used as a read-only search getter.
representatives.coverageLimits: SessionInfo.allMessagesText joins user/assistant text and loses exact message boundaries/IDs; a match may span messages. listAll can provide coarse discovery with cancellation but silently skips some failures. RPC get_messages is for the currently loaded session.
representatives.decision: No accepted exact-message, no-write unloaded reader in the inspected surface. Do not replace it with a private JSONL/database parser or load another session.

proposedFirstSlice.ownership: Inside acp_client only: derive reader eligibility from the user-selected AgentRow command/args and its canonical official registry launch shape. Resolve the existing SDK from that exact adapter installation dependency graph and package export; never from project cwd, PATH guessing, a matching display name, or an arbitrary npm directory. The inspected installation is evidence, not proof that the user has selected it.
proposedFirstSlice.registrationGate: Reuse the existing launch-provenance approach without binary hash/version pinning. Custom wrappers or unresolved package/Node ownership remain unsupported. Use the selected Node launch or existing managed Node associated with that install; no new Agent installation, private HOME, environment override, or user configuration write.
proposedFirstSlice.request: A proposed common transient request carries an unrepeatable request owner, current selected program/service identity, explicit scope, indexed native IDs, cwd and query. The backend advertises read capability plus known omissions. Limit the first slice to already indexed exact IDs; separate wider discovery from body coverage.
proposedFirstSlice.result: Per-session outcome: available official projection, unavailable, changed, unsupported, cancelled or budget-excluded; message ID/role/field boundaries and partial reason. Common UI says official-returned historical body and shows coverage/gaps. Empty SDK output alone never proves the complete history is empty.
proposedFirstSlice.lifetime: No bodies in settings/index/logs. Retain bounded snapshots only for the current search and explicit result view. Query/scope/program changes terminate the private helper and invalidate old output; an active Agent connection and its native session are untouched.
proposedFirstSlice.resourceBoundary: Bound candidate count, preflight SDK-reported local file size when available, message text and serialized stdout before accepting it; enforce an observed wall deadline and measured helper memory ceiling. SDK pagination still reads/projects substantial input and is not a resource cap. Choose numeric reader caps after synthetic measurement, retaining current UI search limits as output limits only.
proposedFirstSlice.jump: Open an ephemeral read-only result snapshot, with exact official message identity and source scope, then revalidate if reread. A stale or unavailable result is explicit. Resuming the real conversation remains a separate user action; clicking a hit must not implicitly call session_load.

requiredAcceptance: Synthetic public SDK import/getter: no file creation, repair, migration, network, Agent child or model request; inspect canaries and exact child lifetime. Do not point this probe at user histories.

Known literal before and after compaction, including a transcript over 5 MiB; multiple branches, skipped/malformed lines, missing/unreadable files and an actual empty conversation. Show omissions rather than full-history no-hit.

Exact selected launch/dependency ownership; wrong cwd, linked-worktree fallback, duplicate native IDs across programs and changed program/service reject stale results. No module resolution through the project.
Mutation during read and changed metadata: no mixed-result claim. SDK stat metadata alone is not an atomic snapshot proof; flag concurrent/unconfirmed reads. No locks or writes to ongoing Agent work.
Cancellation before import/during read/while output streams, helper timeout, output overflow and peak-memory measurement; no surviving private helper and no cancellation of an existing Agent.

Long Markdown plus repeated/Unicode fields, exact message jumps, late results after query/scope changes and no match across joined message boundaries. Attachments cover only returned text, not files/media/OCR.

Common capability-driven UI with accurate partial counts, no brand-specific panels and no persistent transcript ledger. Prove synthetic reader first, then separately authorized installed-product evidence.

officialSources.supports: Codex read/list semantics and experimental pagination; official page read after OpenAI Docs skill.
Public history/session inspection API documentation; Python was not installed or invoked.
Public TS history helpers and subsequent completeness fixes; exact installed signatures/source separately hashed.
Read/parse/pagination and current-chain/compaction limits. Mutable main is a reviewed date checkpoint, not a dependency version.
Existing-client versus server-start distinction and session APIs.
CLI export delegates to session get/messages.
Plugin/configuration initialization, so export is not assumed passive.
Pi file repair/migration and discovery/getter limitations; installed JS separately checked.

retrievalLimit: The Claude TypeScript documentation page exceeded the web reader response limit; this is a retrieval limitation, not evidence of an absent API. Exact public installed d.ts plus mjs and official changelog were used instead.

validation.method: Read-only current code, existing 29-agent evidence, installed software-package files and official documentation/source. No SDK import or getter execution; no user transcript/body/credential/DB inspection; no App, Agent, model request, configuration change, install or test/build. Only this new research JSON is written and formatted.
